name: hospitable-widgets
description: Always-current Hospitable listing widgets for any website: one Cloudflare Worker, one snippet.

HOSPITABLE_PAT.description: Your Hospitable Personal Access Token. Create one in Hospitable under Apps → API access → Personal access tokens (read access is enough). Type dummy to try everything on sample data first.

PUBLIC_GUIDE_TOPICS.description: Optional. Knowledge Hub topic names that may be shown on your website, separated by commas, for example: Local attractions, Restaurants. Leave empty to show none.

BUILDER_URL.description: Where this Worker's home page sends you after deploy. Leave as it is.

LISTINGS.description: Stores the last good copy of your listing data. Cloudflare creates it for you.
